messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's current action with the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select video 0, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands in the middle of the road, shifting her weight and turning her body slightly while looking around.","camera":"A static, low-angle full shot captures the subject from head to toe.","clothing":"She wears a short, black dress with a white and black patterned bodice, puffy short sleeves, and a white panel on the side, paired with light blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Bright yellow-blonde.","hairstyle":"Her hair is styled in a high, rounded bun or topknot.","identity":"A slender young woman with a fair complexion and a small face.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor paved road under a concrete overpass, with orange and white construction barriers, a metal guardrail, and green trees in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output woman no longer performs the original large arm-raising dance. She stands in the same road scene, shifts her weight, turns slightly, raises one hand to cover her face around the middle of the clip, holds that pose, then lowers her arm and returns to a standing pose. Her appearance, clothing, hair, scene, and static low-angle framing remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the woman's current dance-like arm-raising action with the motion shown in the reference: standing, turning slightly, raising one hand to cover the face, holding it, then lowering the arm and returning to a neutral stance, while preserving her identity, clothing, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the subtle timing and body orientation exactly match the reference motion cannot be fully verified from the sampled frames.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly darker or have a different exposure than the source frames.
